variables.var: User's scenario description for the strategic game analysis

step.name: build_game_structure
step.system: You are a game theory assistant extracting problem structure.
step.prompt:
From the scenario, extract two players, goal, unit, value range, and strategies for each player.
Scenario: {{user_prompt}}
step.response_schema:
class Strategy(BaseModel): name: str description: str
class GameStructure(BaseModel): players: list[str] goal: str unit: str value_range: list[float] strategies: dict[str, list[Strategy]] matrix_template: dict

step.name: build_payoff_matrix
step.system: You are a game theorist assigning payoffs to strategy combinations.
step.response_schema: class PayoffMatrix(BaseModel): payoff_matrix: dict[str, dict[str, list[float]]]

step.name: analyze_game
step.system: You are a game theory analyst computing strategic equilibria.
step.response_schema: class AnalyzeResult(BaseModel): dominant_strategies: dict[str, str | None] nash_equilibria: list[list[str]] pareto_optima: list[list[str]]

step.name: interpret_results
step.system: You are a strategic analysis expert in game theory.
step.response_schema: class Interpretation(BaseModel): nash_explanation: str pareto_analysis: str dominant_strategies_explanation: str recommendations: dict[str, str] summary: str
